license_required.quote: A person shall not engage in the practice of ... nursing ... unless the person has obtained a license for that purpose from the board for the profession.

issuing_authority.quote: For nursing and midwifery, the board of nursing.

name.quote: For nursing and midwifery, the board of nursing.

type.quote: For nursing and midwifery, the board of nursing.

umbrella_agency.value: Department of Inspections, Appeals, and Licensing
umbrella_agency.quote: "Department" means the department of inspections, appeals, and licensing.

degree_required.value: Completion of a board-approved course of study (at least two academic years for RN; at least one academic year for LPN)
degree_required.quote: Requires, for graduation of a registered nurse applicant, the completion of at least a two academic year course of study.

accrediting_body.quote: All programs preparing a person to be a registered nurse or a licensed practical nurse shall be approved by the board.

exams.name: NCLEX-RN or NCLEX-PN (national council licensure examination)
exams.notes: Prescribed by the board; for multistate licensure compact purposes, specifically identified as NCLEX-RN or NCLEX-PN
exams.quote: Has successfully passed a national council licensure examination — registered nurse or national council licensure examination — practical nurse examination or recognized predecessor, as applicable.

required.quote: the board of nursing shall establish rules requiring a person licensed pursuant to section ... 152.6 ... who has prescribed opioids to a patient during the previous licensure cycle to receive continuing education credits regarding the United States centers for disease control and prevention guideline for prescribing opioids for chronic pain

value: CDC guideline for prescribing opioids for chronic pain (for those who prescribed opioids in prior cycle)
topical_requirements.quote: receive continuing education credits regarding the United States centers for disease control and prevention guideline for prescribing opioids for chronic pain, including recommendations on limitations on dosages and the length of prescriptions, risk factors for abuse, and nonopioid and nonpharmacologic therapy options

available.quote: A license possessed by an applicant from a state which has not adopted the nurse licensure compact ... shall be recognized by the board under conditions specified which indicate that the licensee meets all the qualifications required under section 152.7.

requirements.value: For non-compact states: board recognizes foreign license if licensee meets Iowa qualifications; may issue license by endorsement without examination. For compact states: recognized pursuant to nurse licensure compact provisions.
requirements.quote: If a foreign license is recognized, the board may issue a license by endorsement without an examination being required. Recognition shall be based on whether the foreign licensee is qualified to practice nursing.

regulatory_model.quote: A person shall not engage in the practice of ... nursing ... unless the person has obtained a license for that purpose from the board for the profession.

credential_type.quote: The board may license a natural person to practice as a registered nurse, as a licensed practical nurse, or as an advanced registered nurse practitioner.

is_mandatory.quote: A person shall not engage in the practice of ... nursing ... unless the person has obtained a license for that purpose from the board for the profession.

title_protection.quote: only a person currently licensed as a registered nurse in this state may use that title and the letters "R.N." after the person's name; only a person currently licensed as a licensed practical nurse in this state may use that title and the letters "L.P.N." after the person's name; and only a person currently licensed as an advanced registered nurse practitioner may use that title and the letters "A.R.N.P." after the person's name.

scope_protection.quote: A person shall not engage in the practice of ... nursing ... unless the person has obtained a license for that purpose from the board for the profession.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual intoxication or addiction to the use of drugs.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud in representations as to skill or ability
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud in representations as to skill or ability.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of untruthful or improbable statements in advertisements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of untruthful or improbable statements in advertisements.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or repeated violations of the provisions of this chapter, chapter 272C, or a board's enabling statute

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful violation of the rules of the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful violation of the rules of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Continued practice while knowingly having an infectious or contagious disease which could be harmful to a patient's welfare
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Continued practice while knowingly having an infectious or contagious disease which could be harmful to a patient's welfare.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a nursing license revoked, suspended, or other disciplinary action taken by a licensing authority of another state, territory, or country
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a license to practice nursing as a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse revoked or suspended, or having other disciplinary action taken by a licensing authority of another state, territory, or country.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly aiding, assisting, procuring, advising, or allowing a person to unlawfully practice nursing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly aiding, assisting, procuring, advising, or allowing a person to unlawfully practice nursing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being adjudicated mentally incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being adjudicated mentally incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction. Such adjudication shall automatically suspend a license for the duration of the license, unless the board orders otherwise.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or repeated departure from or failure to conform to the minimum standard of acceptable and prevailing practice of nursing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being guilty of willful or repeated departure from or the failure to conform to the minimum standard of acceptable and prevailing practice of nursing; however, actual injury to a patient need not be established.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice nursing with reasonable skill and safety by reason of illness, excessive use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or other material or as a result of a mental or physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice nursing with reasonable skill and safety by reason of illness, excessive use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or other type of material or as a result of a mental or physical condition.

definition_quote.value: The 'practice of the profession of a registered nurse' means the practice of a natural person who is licensed by the board to formulate nursing diagnosis and conduct nursing treatment of human responses to actual or potential health problems through services, such as case finding, referral, health teaching, health counseling, and care provision which is supportive to or restorative of life and well-being.
definition_quote.quote: The "practice of the profession of a registered nurse" means the practice of a natural person who is licensed by the board to do all of the following: a. Formulate nursing diagnosis and conduct nursing treatment of human responses to actual or potential health problems through services, such as case finding, referral, health teaching, health counseling, and care provision which is supportive to or restorative of life and well-being.

value: Formulate nursing diagnosis and conduct nursing treatment
Execute regimen prescribed by a physician, advanced registered nurse practitioner, or physician assistant
Supervise and teach other personnel in nursing care
Perform additional acts or nursing specialties requiring education and training
Pronounce death for anticipated patient deaths in specified settings
Assist in administration of immunizations and vaccinations under pharmacist order
Apply scientific principles including nursing skills and biological, physical, and psychosocial sciences
methods_authorized.quote: Formulate nursing diagnosis and conduct nursing treatment of human responses to actual or potential health problems through services, such as case finding, referral, health teaching, health counseling, and care provision which is supportive to or restorative of life and well-being.

drug_authority.value: A registered nurse who is licensed as an advanced registered nurse practitioner may prescribe substances or devices, including controlled substances or devices, if the nurse is engaged in the practice of a nursing specialty regulated under rules adopted by the board of nursing in consultation with the board of medicine and the board of pharmacy.
drug_authority.quote: a registered nurse who is licensed as an advanced registered nurse practitioner may prescribe substances or devices, including controlled substances or devices, if the nurse is engaged in the practice of a nursing specialty regulated under rules adopted by the board of nursing in consultation with the board of medicine and the board of pharmacy.

license_tiers.quote: The board may license a natural person to practice as a registered nurse, as a licensed practical nurse, or as an advanced registered nurse practitioner.

aprn_role_categories.quote: "Advanced practice registered nurse" means a nurse anesthetist, nurse practitioner, nurse midwife, or clinical nurse specialist to the extent a party state licenses or grants authority to practice in that advanced practice registered nurse role and title.

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: Perform services in the provision of supportive or restorative care under the supervision of a registered nurse or a physician.

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: For purposes of this section, "currently licensed" includes persons licensed in another state and recognized for licensure in this state pursuant to the nurse licensure compact contained in section 152E.1 or pursuant to the advanced practice registered nurse compact contained in section 152E.3.

multistate_license_option_available.quote: "Multistate license" means a license to practice as a registered or a licensed practical or vocational nurse issued by a home state licensing board that authorizes the licensed nurse to practice in all party states under a multistate licensure privilege.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: "Alternative program" means a nondisciplinary monitoring program approved by a licensing board.

rn_death_pronouncement_authorized.quote: Make the pronouncement of death for a patient whose death is anticipated if the death occurs in a licensed hospital, a licensed health care facility, a correctional institution listed in section 904.102, a Medicare-certified home health agency, a Medicare-certified hospice program or facility, an assisted living facility, or a residential care facility, with notice of the death to a physician, advanced registered nurse practitioner, or physician assistant.
